"As suggested, moving forward, let's include the specific SQL_ID when requesting query tuning assistance from the L2/L4 team. This will help avoid unnecessary back-and-forth and prevent delays in the investigation process."

The main improvements:

- Simplified "so there is no back and forth questioning" to make it clearer
- Made the sentence flow more naturally
